test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

“We must be vigilant. Our teacher never accepts the assignment if any one of us is late in submission”, Ramesh said to his friend.

options.text: Ramesh told his friend that they must be vigilant as their teacher never accepted the assignment if any one of them was late in submission.
Ramesh said his friend that they must be vigilant as our teacher never accepted the assignment if any one of them was late in submission.
Ramesh said to his friend that we must be vigilant as their teacher never accepted the assignment if any one of them was late in submission.
Ramesh told his friend that we must be vigilant as their teacher never accepted the assignment if any one of them was late in submission.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the steps for changing the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• In the given sentence the reporting verb has an object "his friend". Hence, **'said to'** will be changed into **'told'. **
 
• **Comma (,)** and inverted **commas("...")** will be removed. 
 
• The conjunction '**that**' will be added.
 
• **'We'** will be changed into** 'they'** according to the reporting speech. "We" implies Ramesh and his friend.
 
• **'must' **has no past form hence, it will remain unchanged.
 
• Here, **"accepts"** and **"is late" **turn into **"accepted" **and **"was late" **respectively, because the reporting speech is in the past tense. (Tense change rules are in the additional information)
